flash_690966.description:
Iran warns it has prepared plans to strike US and Israeli energy targets and potentially close the Strait of Hormuz following reports of imminent joint US-Israeli airstrikes.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_690965.description:
Rep. Haley Stevens fires back at progressive Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan's Senate primary, accusing him of scapegoating Jewish Americans over AIPAC.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_690964.description:
US President Donald Trump has ordered a fresh attack on Iran that could begin as soon as this weekend and would last a few days, US officials told The Wall Street Journal on Friday.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_629916.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat in North America, where they are being written now.

Updates will resume Saturday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 20:16 Jerusalem time.

Shabbat Shalom!

flash_690967.description:
The Student Workers of Columbia union drops its contract demand for Columbia to divest from Israel and entities violating international law.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_690963.description:
CBS News reports that the US and Israel are preparing a major air campaign against Iranian energy infrastructure, which could start over the weekend.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_690970.description: Israeli authorities detain off-duty IDF soldier on suspicion of shooting Arab minor shot in Binyamin region.

flash_690969.description: Israeli forces strike five Hamas weapons storage facilities across Gaza, including cache hidden beside Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital.

flash_690974.description: MK Uri Maklev questions Netanyahu's loyalty to the right-wing bloc, predicts he may seek a coalition with Gadi Eisenkot.

flash_690973.description: Detained off-duty soldier left home to help a shepherd under attack, never fired a shot, legal organization says.

flash_690971.description: US officials investigating wave of cyber intrusions targeting water utilities across seven states, The New York Times reports.

flash_690968.description: IDF officer moderately injured in southern Lebanon evacuated for medical treatment.

flash_690978.description: Trump Media has launched a premium Truth Social service allowing subscribers to view President Trump’s posts before the public, drawing criticism from Democratic senators who are calling for an SEC investigation.

flash_690977.description: US State Department warns Americans in Middle East to consider leaving, citing risk of sudden airspace closures, flight disruptions, and attacks on US interests.

flash_690975.description: British band Massive Attack has been barred from returning to Singapore after members displayed a Palestinian flag and shouted political slogans during a concert.

flash_690972.description: Israeli officials believe President Donald Trump is nearing a decision on possible military action against Iran, with growing concerns that any US strike could quickly draw Israel into a wider regional conflict.

flash_690979.description: Israel, the nation that beat Hamas to a pulp in response to the slaughter of Oct. 7, 2023, gets to play the part of the loser in Trump's peace plan. Opinion.

flash_690976.description: Dozens of haredi demonstrators protest outside Jerusalem café open on Sabbath during visit by Yisrael Beytenu leader MK Avigdor Liberman.

flash_690985.description: What Americans in Israel should know before assuming a U.S. portfolio built for someone else still makes sense today.

flash_690984.description: Police are investigating a suspicious overnight fire that heavily damaged Nöam, a Montreal kosher restaurant, as leaders raise concerns of hate-motivated arson.

flash_690982.description:
Gaza medical sources report that at least four people were killed in Israeli Air Force strikes in Gaza City and Deir al-Balah.

According to the reports, an airstrike targeting an apartment in the central Gaza Strip killed two people and injured four others, while a separate strike on a building in Gaza City left two additional people dead.

flash_690981.description:
US President Donald Trump wrote in a post on Truth Social, "The U.S.A. is locked and loaded and ready to go against the Islamic Republic of Iran, at levels of Military Terror, Strength, and Power not seen since World War II. Despite this, we have just been asked by Iran, and other Middle Eastern Countries, to hold off any attack in that the perimeters of a deal has been agreed to. This would include the Immediate, Complete, and Total OPENING OF THE HORMUZ STRAIT, and an end to Iran’s nuclear threat."

He added, "Based on this request, I have agreed, for the future benefit of the WORLD and, likewise, the survival of a successful and prosperous Iran, to cancel the attack, subject to being able to rapidly make a DEAL. The Country of Israel joins me in this commitment. Get to work, everybody, and get it DONE."

flash_690993.description: A campaign aimed at weakening the regime’s governing capacity. Opinion

flash_690992.description: Yisrael Beytenu chairman rejects the debate over who should be the next prime minister and rules out any cooperation with the Ra'am party.

flash_690990.description: IDF eliminates Nukhba commander Salem Jamal Abd al-Rahman Abu Labad, who took part in the massacre in Kibbut Nahal Oz.

flash_690988.description: A significant increase in the heat load is expected throughout the day, with extreme heat conditions across the country. A noticeable cooldown is expected by Wednesday.

flash_690986.description: IDF spokesman shares his personal experience with PTSD and tells combat veterans: 'Treatment is not a sign of weakness. On the contrary, it's an act of responsibility toward yourself and toward the people you love.'

flash_691005.description: The Saudi Al-Arabiya channel reported from its sources that the Palestinian Islamic Jihad terrorist organization has agreed to disarm.

flash_691004.description: An explosive device disguised as a gift detonated at the entrance to an upscale restaurant in central Moscow during a private, heavily secured event.

flash_691003.description: New South Wales Supreme Court overturns ruling that excluded viral footage allegedly showing two former nurses making threats against Israelis, allowing prosecutors to present the video at trial.

flash_691002.description: Brayton Laschinger allegedly smashed a synagogue window with a brick, telling police he targeted the site because it was a 'Jewish place of worship' after viewing antisemitic content online.

flash_691001.description: Former prime minister Naftali Bennett says his casual attire reflects his desire to 'be free' while traveling around Israel, but hints he expects to return to formal dress when he becomes prime minister again.

flash_690999.description: When Israelis ask Washington to take action against Jews in Judea and Samaria, followed by Bret Stephens and the WSJ, they are ignoring the context of Arab terrorism and attempting an end run around democracy for political reasons. Opinion.

flash_690997.description: The Torah does not command the blessings over food before eating, only after - so why do we do so?

flash_691011.description: Attorney Yonatan Jakubowicz says Spain's immigration policies are encouraging illegal migration into EU territory, warning that Europe may soon find it impossible to reverse the trend.

flash_691010.description: PM Netanyahu said the law freezing draft evader arrests failed to boost haredi enlistment, pledging new legislation after the elections: 'Those who do not study Torah will enlist - or go to prison.'

flash_691009.description: Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich offers Rabbi Avraham Zarbib the secured second spot on the Religious Zionist Party’s list and even considers appointing him as a minister, but Rabbi Zarbib turns down the offer.

flash_691007.description: Moriah Asraf warns Yair Golan's campaign to cut funding for Eli Academy, with high percentages of IDF serving graduates, is alienating centrist and right-wing voters seeking to replace the government.

flash_691017.description: Reports from Gaza: 12 killed in airstrikes since last night

flash_691016.description: An 11-year-old boy is recovering after suffering a rare and potentially life-threatening injury when an arrow penetrated his skull during an archery activity at a day camp.

flash_691014.description: Brig. Gen. (res.) Solomon recounts the events of October 7 from the perspective of the Israeli Navy & discusses Hamas's deadly naval capabilities.

flash_691013.description:
Police in the Jerusalem district arrested six suspects, including five minors and an adult, on suspicion of spitting at the Armenian Church and throwing stones at it in the Old City of Jerusalem.

Three of the suspects are being brought to the Jerusalem Magistrate's Court for a hearing on extending their detention, while the rest were released under restrictive conditions, including being banned from the Old City.

flash_691012.description: The Lebanese army claims that five of its soldiers were lightly injured in an Israeli attack in the Bint Jbeil area in southern Lebanon.

flash_691008.description: The security analyst believes that greater attention should be paid to the actions the United States is taking on the ground than to public statements.

flash_691023.description: Yemeni Army says it killed five Houthi terrorists in clashes

flash_691022.description: The Israel Fire and Rescue Authority announced that firefighters have brought the blaze near the moshav of Ksalon under control. The authority said there is no longer any danger to nearby homes, and that firefighting crews are continuing operations to fully extinguish the remaining hotspots.

flash_691020.description:
About 30 firefighting crews and six firefighting aircraft are battling a brush fire spreading through a wooded area near the moshav of Ksalon in the Beit Shemesh region.

The Israel Fire and Rescue Authority said the first row of homes in the Megillot Ha'Esh neighborhood of the community has begun to be evacuated, and that firefighters are concentrating their efforts on containing the blaze and protecting nearby buildings.

Read more.

flash_691019.description:
Yesterday (Saturday), the IDF struck in the area of Gaza City and eliminated Alaa Imad Khamis Tarams, a terrorist from the “Army of Islam" terrorist organization, and Hassan Ibrahim Shehadeh Qahman, a terrorist from the Islamic Jihad terrorist organization.

In an additional strike in the northern Gaza Strip last week, the IDF eliminated Ahmad Khudar, a commander in the Jabalya battalion of the Hamas terrorist organization.

The three terrorists attempted to advance terror attacks against Israeli civilians and IDF troops, and were eliminated in order to remove the threat.

flash_691015.description: Ex-Likud member and former ambassador Gilad Erdan vows that he will not sit in a narrow government.

flash_691029.description: The Jerusalem District Court on Sunday issued an interim order temporarily blocking the state's plan to transfer Nile crocodiles to Ketzi'ot Prison as part of the defenses around captured Hamas terrorists.

flash_691028.description: Detectives from the Ramla Police Station locate three pipe bombs and dozens of rounds of stolen IDF ammunition near the city's railway station.

flash_691026.description:
Officers from the Israel Police Central District uncovered three high-powered pipe bombs and dozens of 5.56 mm rounds, which police believe were stolen from the IDF, during a search of an open area near the Ramla Railway Station.

Police said the operation thwarted what they described as a “criminal terror attack" in the Arab sector. The explosive devices were neutralized by a police bomb disposal expert, and the evidence was transferred for further investigation and forensic examination.

flash_691025.description:
In a social media post in English, Knesset Member Benny Gantz (Blue and White) addressed the current deal with Hamas, warning that Israel cannot compromise on full disarmament.

Gantz related how shortly after joining the War Cabinet after October 7th, he met various US generals who had one piece of advice when it came to Gaza & Hamas: “Don’t rush to your failure". According to Gantz, he responded: “You must understand - Gaza isn’t a far away mission for us, it’s a few hundred metres from Israeli homes; children, families. We don’t have the privilege of not acting now".

Gantz wrote that "today, Israel cannot compromise on Hamas’ full disarmament in Gaza before retreating from further territory. The price of failure isn’t a failed mission far away - it’s the security of our children."

flash_691021.description: Four and a half months after making an emergency landing at Ben-Gurion Airport following an air collision over Iraq, the American refueling aircraft took off back to the United States.

flash_691033.description: Police and IDF confirm preparations to evacuate the UNRWA compound in Kafr Aqab after months of delays and security concerns.

flash_691032.description: Ben Carasso tells Arutz Sheva how a friend's loss after October 7 inspired his global advocacy campaign, why he believes the battle for public opinion is focused on the "neutral majority," and why children have a unique voice in defending Israel.

flash_691027.description: CAM report says antisemitic conspiracy theories linking Israel to the Ceuta migrant surge reached more than 100 million people on X within 72 hours, as prominent pages share it.

flash_691024.description: American Airlines delays return to Israel to March 2027

flash_691038.description: The U.S. Central Command released footage of the launch of a carrier-based fighter jet taking off in the Arabian Sea as part of operations against Iran.

flash_691037.description: Benett drops to 13 seats, Golan drops to eight, Ofer Winter and Erdan and Edelstein stay behind electoral threshold. Netanyahu and Eisenkot tied for lead.

flash_691035.description: Iranian News Agency (IRNA) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said that there has been progress in the talks between Iran and Oman, confirming that they are moving toward finalizing the agreement and entering the final stages.

flash_691031.description: Media outlets in the Gaza Strip are reporting that Nafedh Tzabih, a senior figure in the military wing of Hamas, was killed in a strike on a vehicle in Gaza City in the northern part of the enclave.

flash_691030.description: Israeli soccer player Dor Turgeman responds to chants of 'Death to Israel' in the best way he could.

flash_691043.description: President Trump announces US-Iran talks will resume on Monday after Middle Eastern allies persuade him to hold off on a massive attack to pursue a diplomatic deal.

flash_691042.description: The IDF Spokesperson’s Unit responded to Defense Minister Israel Katz and said, “The statement issued by the Minister of Defense was not coordinated with the Chief of the General Staff. The Chief of the General Staff does not intend to change key IDF commanders' positions during these sensitive times. Once such a decision is made, it will be taken by the Chief of the General Staff and approved in accordance with the required protocols."

flash_691040.description: A proposal that is different: barriers that separate Gaza's population from Hamas. Details below. Op-ed.

flash_691036.description:
The Director General of the Board of Peace in Gaza, Nickolay Mladenov, condemned Israeli strikes on Gaza over the past two days, claiming that they have "killed civilians and destroyed medical supplies that people depend on."

He noted that the strikes come after "intense efforts by the Board of Peace and the mediators (Egypt, Turkiye, Qatar and the US) to bring the Palestinian factions in Gaza to agree to a Roadmap on the full implementation of President Trump's plan, to hand over civilian governance and to decommission their weapons."

Mladenov stressed that "both parties carry obligations under the Comprehensive Plan and the Sharm El Sheikh deal that secured the release of all hostages."

"My team and I are working around the clock with the parties, the mediators and regional partners to de-escalate and create the space for the full implementation of the President's plan. Achieving a lasting peace is hard but achievable if everyone make their best efforts," he added.

flash_691034.description:
The IDF announced on Sunday that, following a review and contrary to claims, it was confirmed that the explosive device that exploded on a Lebanese Armed Forces vehicle earlier in the day, injuring five LAF soldiers, did not belong to the IDF.

According to the information available to the IDF, the explosive device is assessed to have belonged to the Hezbollah terrorist organization. The incident occurred in the Kfara area, outside the Security Zone in southern Lebanon, where no IDF soldiers had any presence.

Read more.

flash_691044.description:
The IDF announced that a Naval exercise will take place starting Monday morning through Tuesday evening in the maritime area between Shavei Tzion and Ashdod.

Increased activity of security forces and naval vessels will be noticeable throughout the exercise. The IDF emphasized that this is a pre-planned exercise and there is no cause for security concern.

flash_691041.description: During an interview on Channel 14, Defense Minister Israel Katz announces his decision to appoint Maj. Gen. Dado Bar Kalifa as Head of Central Command, replacing Avi Bluth.

flash_691039.description: Ten days after the disappearance of 16-year-old Efrat Menachem from Kokhav Ya'akov, Israel Police are continuing their search efforts and urging the public to report any leads.

flash_691046.description:
Saudi Foreign Minister Faisal bin Farhan held a telephone conversation with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi amid intense diplomatic efforts by Riyadh to prevent a regional escalation and advance an agreement between the United States and Iran.

According to a statement from the Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the call focused on reviewing diplomatic steps to ease tensions. During the conversation, Bin Farhan emphasized the Kingdom's commitment to continuing "its regional role in establishing security and stability, in a manner that achieves the shared interests of all nations and peoples in the region."

flash_691045.description: Shas faction chairman Yinon Azoulay announces that settling the draft status of yeshiva students will be a baseline requirement for the party joining any post-election government.

flash_691054.description: American Airlines extends its Tel Aviv flight pause to March 28, 2027, making it the only major US carrier out of Israel since October 2023.

flash_691053.description: Board of Peace chief Nickolay Mladenov criticizes recent Israeli strikes in Gaza, warning they threaten efforts to disarm Hamas.

flash_691051.description: President Masoud Pezeshkian says Iran must force the US to abide by its signed peace MoU, calling the accord central to future security.

flash_691049.description: A tanker off Oman reports a nearby explosion with no damage or injuries, occurring just after President Trump announced US-Iran talks would resume.

flash_691047.description:
An earthquake was felt early Monday morning in the Dead Sea area, according to the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC).

Reports indicate that the tremor was felt across central and southern Israel, with emergency alerts triggered on some mobile devices.

flash_691063.description: More than two years after his death, fallen IDF officer’s family receives unexpected ‘message from Eitan,' following a mistaken identification between the surnames Fish and Fischer.

flash_691062.description: Indictment filed against Nur Shams Battalion commander for the murder of IDF reservist Sergeant first class (res.) Yehuda Geto in July 2024, as well as numerous terror-related offenses.

flash_691060.description: Reserve soldiers in the Paratroopers Brigade purchased eSIM cards from Lebanese sources during the fighting in Lebanon, in violation of military regulations and without security authorization.

flash_691058.description: Spanish actor Javier Bardem sparked backlash after posting on social media, 'we know who benefits from a weakened, destabilized Spain: Israel, and the Western far right eager to turn migration into a weapon against Muslims.'

flash_691056.description: Dear President Trump, you did an excellent job at first but aren't you now starting to behave like most politicians, destroying with one hand what the other hand has painstakingly built? Opinion.

flash_691073.description: Using the term "West Bank" shows how thoroughly some Israelis have internalized the language of their adversaries. Opinion.

flash_691072.description: Monty Goldstein, who defended Britain during WWII, says rising antisemitism has left him wondering why Jews are once again paying the price for hatred, while calling life at 102 a gift from G-d.

flash_691070.description: Arnold Roth’s 25-year fight for his daughter's murder and accountability for a Hamas terrorist.

flash_691068.description: Former MK serving in senior Likud role is detained alongside well-known contractor, other businessmen, over allegations of sophisticated fraud scheme.

flash_691066.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz accuses critics of spreading 'outright lie' after reports claimed he sought to dismiss Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth, insisting the appointment of Bluth's successor had been underway for months.

flash_691064.description: Haredi factions disagree on response to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's statements on law preventing arrest of haredi draft evaders, exposing internal rift.
